title: Chapter 6134: Could Have Given It To Me

Chapter 6134: Could Have Given It To Me

Chapter 6134: Could Have Given It To Me

Blood flowed to the ground; its stench made others shudder. They exchanged glances of shock and confusion.

How could the second strongest cultivator in Sin be beaten in this manner? He was Specter Ancestor, someone who had dominated for eras.

Moreover, how did Li Qiye take out and use the heavenly scripture like a brick? This was an unprecedented feat.

Just taking one law from the heavenly scripture like Specter Ancestor was impressive enough, but Li Qiye grabbed the whole thing only to use it so wastefully.

“How many more smashes can you take given your shoddy cultivation?” Li Qiye asked.

Specter Ancestor’s eyes narrowed as he realized Li Qiye’s dreadful potential. He staggered backward as Li Qiye came closer.

Spectators stared at the ancestor’s pulverized face and the heavenly scripture with bated breath.

Specter took a deep breath to calm down. Although he was no match for Li Qiye, he could still stand proudly without begging for mercy.

“Sir, please show mercy and forgive him.” An old man appeared before Li Qiye and bowed his head.

“Ancestor Kundali.” Many recognized him - the other ancestor of Phantom. They had wondered about his lack of attendance during the main battle a while ago.

“Came just in time, I see.” Li Qiye said.

“Sir, Brother Specter is just blinded by rage, please be benevolent. We will not disturb you any longer.” Kundali bowed and grabbed the unwilling Specter Ancestor.

He carried the guy away whilst Li Qiye still had no intent to kill. Sure enough, Li Qiye didn’t stop them.

This left Li Qiye and everyone else who didn’t dare to say a thing. Some lacked the courage to stare at Li Qiye.

Everyone felt this was the decline of Phantom Dynasty. Although its ancestors were still alive, they lost key emperors. Of course, destruction was far away since the two ancestors were still around but would it be able to rise again?

Li Qiye casually opened the scripture and flipped through the pages. Wondrous light and auspicious signs emerged. One could see a heavenly world with dao laws being created and multiplied.

Each dao could be a way to the other shore by just comprehending them. It granted immense strength and future potential.

Everyone didn’t dare to wink or miss a moment of this opportunity. Obtaining this scripture meant becoming an emperor regardless of one’s innate talent. They could then start a lineage lasting for eras in Sin.

However, Li Qiye flipped through the pages quickly and said: “Heavenly scripture? What an exaggeration.”

Having said that, he tossed it back into the pond as if it were nothing more than a book to be read for entertainment.

This stunned the crowd since even primal ancestors coveted it.

“He’s the only one who would do this.” Someone felt a deep pain in their heart.

“If he didn’t want it, he could have given it to me…” Emperors and desolate gods lamented.

“If you don’t open it now, I will.” Li Qiye turned his sight toward the emissaries.

“Coming, coming.” Fog and Water Emissary immediately ran over and said: “Sir, we will get it done, no need to trouble you.”

Li Qiye would do more than just grab a sigil; he would extract all the laws and put an end to the ghost market.

The bald man also came since he was Gold Emissary.

“Okay, Devil, come out.” Water said.

A dark light flashed and Devil Emissary appeared. He had no choice either since the others would force him out. He wouldn’t beat three emissaries, especially not Gold Emissary who was the strongest.

“Still missing one.” Li Qiye said.

The final was Nameless Emissary, the most enigmatic of the five.
